title: German Beef Stir Fry
description: A hearty German twist on the classic stir fry, featuring caramelized beef and a blend of Asian-inspired spices.

ingredients.name: Beef (sirloin or ribeye), sliced into thin strips

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bamboo shoots, caramelized onions, and Thai stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce and vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Cook the German mustard according to package instructions (e.g., mix with a small amount of water).
Combine the cooked mustard with the beef and sauce mixture in the skillet.
Stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
